title: Emfit HRV Baseline RMSSD Leaderboard
dataSources: HRV (`hrv:reading`), blood oxygen (`spo2:reading`), lab panels (`bloodpanel:result`), supplements (`supplement:intake`), continuous glucose (`cgm:glucose`), sleep-apnea events (`apnea:event`), body composition (`bodycomp:measure`), blood pressure (`bloodpressure:reading`).
app: Biohacking data — HRV straps, pulse oximeters, blood-pressure cuffs, continuous glucose monitors, body-composition scales, lab-result exports, and supplement logs — ingested to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=emfit:hrv rmssd_ms=*
| stats sum(rmssd_ms) as total_value, avg(rmssd_ms) as avg_value by sleeper
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks sleeper values by total and average rmssd across Emfit HRV baseline events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `rmssd_ms` values for each Emfit HRV baseline event and review total and average rmssd by sleeper.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total rmssd.
grandmaExplanation: It honestly which sleeper shows the biggest rmssd numbers in your Emfit HRV baseline data.
